narrator.name: Narrator
narrator.look: The second voice of the deep dive: dark blazer, open collar, leaning in with questions and pushback.

everyman.name: The Absurd Man
everyman.look: The 'you' the essay is about: shirtsleeves, mid-stride through routine, weariness and lucidity alternating on his face.

camus.name: Camus
camus.look: Albert Camus as the hosts invoke him: trench coat, collar up against the absurd wind.

kierkegaard.name: Kierkegaard
kierkegaard.look: The leap-of-faith thinkers (Kierkegaard, Chestov, Jaspers, Ignatius): black clerical coat, high collar, vertiginous gaze.

donjuan.name: Don Juan
donjuan.look: Camus's seducer archetype: unbuttoned evening shirt, red rose, multiplying the present moment.

kirillov.name: Kirillov
kirillov.look: Dostoevsky's engineer and Kafka's accused: grey workman's tunic, lamp-pale face, holding the pen of his own proof.

sisyphus.name: Sisyphus
sisyphus.look: The condemned man of the myth: bare-armed laborer in a stone-grey tunic, palms raw against the rock, the defiant smile.
